Prepare state implementation plans and district-wise micro plans (currently 2 districts in Meghalaya Ensure achievement of project targets within timelines. Supervise and support district implementation teams. Coordinate with National Programme Team on implementation progress. 2. Stakeholder Coordination Establish and maintain relationships with State Health Department, Education Department, Women & Child Development Department, State Immunization Officers, NHM officials, District Administrations Facilitate approvals, MoUs and coordination meetings. Lead School level Implementation of Programme Plan & Conduct Mapping of Schools, Identify and engage Schools interested in the programme and collect all the data in specific formats. Share IEC material and ensure that timely notifications and reminders are sent by school staff to the students regarding the vaccination programme. Plan and Conduct Expert session in a School with the support of teachers and students after school. Maintain record of teachers, students, parents attending sessions, identify students who got vaccinated and under the program (school ambassador).  Ensure implementation follows approved workplan and quality standards. 4. Community mobilisation and PHC Engagement Identify and engage 5-6 PHC (in both the districts) where the staff can be motivated and trained to promote HPV vaccination at their centre and localities. Plan and conduct Community outreach with the support of PHC staff and local volunteers. Conduct regular meetings with local representatives/influencers, religious leaders to promote the acceptance of programme Establish and lead a network of volunteers (atleast 4 at state level) who will plan and conduct awareness campaigns in both districts. These volunteers will be part of Gully Youth lab initiative under the programme. Plan and conduct Behaviour Change Communication activities like engaging Youth rock bands, Engaging Social media influencers and other such platforms to promote the GEI Teeka Talk campaign and HPV vaccination awareness campaigns. Coordinate with Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs), Village Health Sanitation and Nutrition Committees (VHSNCs), Anganwadi Workers, Self-Help Groups (SHGs), youth groups, schools, and community-based organisations. Build rapport with community leaders to enhance acceptance and utilisation of telemedicine services. Encourage community ownership and participation in project activities like special day celebrations, . 5. Team Management Supervise assigned District Coordinators and provide support when required. Conduct supportive supervision visits to the assigned districts Conduct performance reviews Resolve implementation bottlenecks Ensure safeguarding compliance Manage state office and keep track of all inventories and expenditures Maintain regular communication with the Reporting officer and provide regular updated related to the programme. Support in organising state level events, workshops, ToT 6. Data Collection, Documentation & Reporting Daily data collection and documentation in meaningful way. Monitoring and evaluation of the quality of data collected from the assigned districts. Provide support in preparing Monthly reports and Quarterly reports Collect Program specific case studies, success stories, best practices and share with the national team Ensure compliance of all safeguarding protocols and consents for capturing and collecting any data for the programme. Any Other Responsibility Perform any other community engagement or project-related responsibilities assigned by the National Programme or ISRN management. Required Qualifications Master's degree in Public Health, Social Work, Rural Development, Health Management, Sociology or related discipline. Experience Essential 6–8 years in public health or development programmes. Minimum 3 years managing multi-district projects. Experience working with Government departments. Experience in donor-funded projects. Preferred Experience in adolescent health (HPV/RMNCAH+/SBCC programmes) Preference will be given to candidates with local presence and familiarity with the proposed state Travel Extensive travel (60–70%) across intervention districts and to other state if required.

review_candidates.description: Title: Senior Finance Systems Analyst Department: Corporate Finance  Reporting to: Senior Director of Transformation Compensation:   CAD82K - CAD111K Employment: Full Time Location: Remote - Canada (Candidates based in British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Nova Scotia or willing to relocate)   Who we are:  World Education Services (WES) is a non-profit social enterprise that supports the educational, economic, and social inclusion of immigrants, refugees, and international students. For 50 years, WES has set the standard for international academic credential evaluation, supporting millions of people as they seek to achieve their academic and professional goals. Through decades of experience as a leader in global education, WES has developed a wide range of tools to pursue social impact at scale. From evaluating academic credentials to shaping policy, designing programs, and providing philanthropic funding, we partner with a diverse set of organizations, leaders, and networks to uplift individuals and drive systems change. Together with its partners, WES enables people to learn, work, and thrive in new places. For more information about WES, please visit our website at www.WES.org. About the Opportunity:  The Senior Finance Systems Analyst leads WES’s finance technology environment by administering, optimizing, and improving the systems that enable accounting, treasury, investments, reporting, and finance operations. Reporting to the Senior Director of Transformation, this role serves as a key finance systems partner for Sage Intacct and related platforms, helping ensure systems are reliable, well-controlled, integrated, and aligned to finance process needs. The role supports system configuration, user access, workflows, reporting, testing, documentation, vendor coordination, and process automation across finance systems. This role also partners with Finance, IT, external vendors, and system users to improve data quality, strengthen controls, reduce manual work, and deliver scalable global finance operations. Responsibilities: Own and administer Sage Intacct and related finance systems, including configuration, module support, workflow setup, reporting enhancements, user access, role permissions, and ongoing system updates and optimization. Provide system support and training to finance users, including troubleshooting, guidance on system functionality, executes new implementations, and delivers reporting, and process tools. Develop and maintain SOPs, policies, checklists, user guides, system documentation, and process documentation for finance systems and related workflows. Establish and support data controls, including data quality monitoring, process documentation, reporting governance, audit readiness, and compliance support for finance systems and workflows. Experience working with external implementation partners, consultants, technology vendors, IT teams, and finance users to support system changes, integrations, issue resolution, and user adoption. Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with ability to translate finance operational needs into system functionality and manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Ability to operate autonomously while being a team player who brings a positive attitude. Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and dynamic team environment. Strong alignment with WES mission and values. Desired Experience in a nonprofit, social enterprise, or mission-driven organization. Familiarity with Sage Intacct, Vena, Salesforce, or UKG. review_candidates.description: Company Description Company Overview: https://www.msxi.com/en/ At MSX International , we’ve been partnering with le ading automotive companies for over 25 years, helping them enhance their retail strategies and streamline operations. Our expertise in areas like dealer performance, repair optimization, and consumer engagement positions us as a trusted partner in the evolving mobility industry. Job Description Job Summary: The Diagnostic Support Engineer will be responsible for monitoring DTC (Diagnostic Trouble Codes) and CAN (Controller Area Network) parameters at the Command Center (CC) 24/7. The role involves guiding customers and drivers, managing escalations, and coordinating with dealers to resolve vehicle issues efficiently. Location: Oragadam, Tamil Nadu Experience: 1-2 years Industry: Automotive Working Days : 6 days (Rotational week off & National Holidays) Key Responsibilities 24/7 Monitoring: Monitor DTC/CAN parameters at the Command Centre and raise tickets immediately when an issue is detected. Ticketing: Respond to triggered DTC/CAN alerts by creating internal tickets in the DMS system (with automation in phase 2). Customer Assistance: Provide Level 1 (L1) support over the phone, guiding customers/drivers to resolve minor issues. Critical DTCs: For vehicles with critical DTCs (e.g., "Service Now" category), guide them to the nearest dealer. Vehicle Breakdown: If a vehicle is immovable, or if further damage could occur, instruct the dealer to reach the vehicle’s location. Issue Tracking: Coordinate with dealers to ensure the issue/ticket is resolved completely and in a timely manner. Management Reporting: Provide daily, weekly, monthly, and ad-hoc reports on vehicle issues and resolution status. KPI Tracking: Track and report KPI targets in the required format. Job Card Analysis: Conduct job card analysis, focusing on cost avoidance, analytics, and reporting for continuous improvement. With a proven track record and a commitment to excellence, we're your trusted partner in the pursuit of career success. Our extensive network, personalized approach, and supportive guidance ensure that you're in the best hands to find your next job opportunity. Job Title: Remote Account Executive (100% Work From Home) Location: Remote from Latin America Position Type: Full-time Salary : $2,100 USD/month + Comissions Schedule: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM US Eastern Time / ET Job Overview Our Client functions as a premier business development partner for independent, high-quality clinical research sites and Principal Investigators (PIs) across the United States. Operating with high operational precision, our client bridges the gap between independent research facilities and global pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical-device companies, and Contract Research Organizations (CROs). By establishing scalable outreach pipelines, conducting rigorous protocol feasibility, and cultivating long-term relationships with clinical operations decision-makers, our client ensures independent sites secure awarded Phase I–IV clinical trials. The Role Our Client is seeking a strategic, relationship-driven B2B Clinical Trial Business Development Specialist to build and execute a repeatable B2B pipeline that connects qualified independent research sites with upcoming clinical trials. Reporting directly to business development leadership, this professional will proactively identify upcoming clinical trials, perform granular site-to-protocol matching, locate key sponsor/CRO decision-makers, manage feasibility questionnaire workflows, and persistently navigate opportunities through every stage of the business development pipeline. Key Responsibilities Clinical Trial Sourcing & Opportunity Identification Continuously scans industry platforms (ClinicalTrials.gov, sponsor/CRO pipelines, press releases, FDA announcements, LinkedIn, and feasibility portals) to discover upcoming Phase I–IV, observational, device, and diagnostic trials. Prioritizes pre-recruitment and active startup opportunities (e.g., "Not Yet Recruiting", "Planned Phase II/III") before widespread site selection is finalized. Targets decision-makers across pharmaceutical, biotech, medical-device, CRO, and clinical trial vendor networks, paying close attention to emerging biotech companies. Protocol Analysis & Precision Site Matching Conducts rigorous protocol analysis to evaluate study requirements, medical specialty needs, inclusion/exclusion criteria, equipment needs, and operational parameters. Compiles internal opportunity summaries, assigning strict fit ratings (A/B/C) based on a site’s genuine recruitment capabilities, PI credentials, patient populations, and site infrastructure. Ensures every outreach is backed by a clear value proposition explaining why a specific PI and site are uniquely positioned to deliver protocol success. Sponsor/CRO Outreach & Relationship Management Identifies, maps, and contacts key decision-makers (Clinical Operations Directors, Feasibility Managers, Clinical Trial Managers, Site Engagement Leads, and Study Startup Specialists). Initiates concise, highly personalized outreach communications focused on securing feasibility consideration rather than generic sales messaging. Maintains a disciplined follow-up cadence (Day 1, 4, 8, 15, and 30) while building long-term, repeatable relationships with sponsor/CRO personnel. Feasibility Coordination & Pipeline Administration Requests, completes, and coordinates detailed Feasibility Questionnaires (FKs) in close alignment with site capability data, ensuring 100% data integrity without overstating patient estimates. Logs and updates every pipeline activity in the central CRM, tracking metrics across 12 distinct pipeline stages—from initial discovery to final study award or loss analysis. Consistently achieves daily operational targets (10–20 trials reviewed, 5–10 qualified opportunities, 5+ new decision-maker contacts, 10–20 personalized communications, and 10+ follow-ups). Prepares weekly executive reports detailing new opportunities, submitted feasibilities, study awards, high-priority prospects, and operational site needs. Qualifications, Skills, and Key Competencies Required Qualifications Clinical Research Domain Knowledge: 2+ years of experience in B2B business development, feasibility coordination, clinical operations, or site selection within the clinical research, pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO industries. B2B Pipeline & CRM Mastery: Proven track record managing structured B2B sales/BD pipelines, logging touchpoints, and maintaining strict CRM hygiene. Advanced English Communication: C1-level English proficiency (CEFR) with exceptional written and verbal communication skills tailored for executive and clinical operations leadership. Protocol & Data Literacy: Ability to review clinical trial protocols, analyze medical eligibility criteria, evaluate investigator CVs, and assess facility technical capabilities. Strategic Prospecting Skills: Expert capability in sourcing decision-makers via ClinicalTrials.gov, LinkedIn, sponsor/CRO feasibility portals, and industry directories. Schedule Alignment: Full availability to work standard US Eastern business hours (Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET). Remote Infrastructure: Dedicated quiet home office, high-performance workstation, webcam, headset, and reliable high-speed internet. Preferred Qualifications Direct prior experience working within a Site Management Organization (SMO), Clinical Research Organization (CRO), or independent clinical trial site network. Existing contacts or familiarity with sponsor/CRO feasibility, site selection, and clinical operations departments in the US. Experience utilizing multi-agent business development structures (Hunter / Outreach / Protocol Feasibility functions). Benefits Competitive Baseline Compensation: Fixed monthly salary of $2,100 USD. Consistent Work Structure: Full-time schedule with stable Monday – Friday US Eastern business hours. Professional Impact: High-visibility position directly driving study awards for top-tier clinical research sites across the United States. 100% Remote Infrastructure: Execute strategic BD workflows remotely from anywhere in Latin America.

review_candidates.title: Regional Manager of Cut Produce
review_candidates.description: Description Job Summary: The Regional Manager of Cut Produce Kiosks will oversee the operations, sales, and distribution of cut produce products across franchisee-run kiosks within an assigned region. This role involves ensuring that franchisees maintain company standards, achieve operational efficiency, and meet sales targets. The Regional Manager will collaborate closely with franchisees, host locations, sales teams, and supply chain personnel to optimize operations and drive growth in the cut produce sector. This position focuses on fostering franchisee success in alignment with GBC Food Services, LLC’s “win-win-win” model, which emphasizes mutual benefit for the company, franchisees, and customers. Key responsibilities include providing guidance, ensuring compliance with brand standards, assisting in marketing strategies, and driving operational excellence. Supervisory Responsibilities Spearhead hiring and training efforts for Regional Managers and Field Supervisors. Coordinate and manage schedules for department managers. Conduct comprehensive and timely performance evaluations. Oversee disciplinary actions and terminations, ensuring alignment with company policy. Primary Duties/Responsibilities Analyze and implement strategies based on P&L statements. Attend and report on sales meetings. Conduct and document regular store visits. Uphold Supreme Service Solutions operational standards. Support store recruitment, new openings, and transitions. Foster strong relationships with store managers and Franchisees. Oversee sales flow and devise strategies for sales improvement. Manage Menu items bar until Franchisee takeover. Recruit and supervise local chefs and Franchisees. Serve as the primary point of contact for the designated region. Report to the Director of Franchisee Operations. Execute compliance audits. Champion initiatives to boost regional sales. Ensure Franchisee orders meet set targets. Understand and advise on steritech audits. Evaluate and enhance company efficiency and effectiveness. Review and improve business procedures and day-to-day operations. Prioritize safety and adequacy of work environments. Enhance customer satisfaction through policy and procedure adjustments. Oversee the entirety of operations for the designated region. Compile weekly reports on regional operations. Represent the company positively to various stakeholders. Organize and manage Menu items Chef replacements and operational contingencies. Secondary Duties/Responsibilities Mastery of Technical Skills, Regulatory/Food Safety & Brand Knowledge, Problem Solving Skills, and Leadership Skills. Aiming for excellence in Leadership Skills. Pursue continued personal and professional development. Requirements Required Skills/Abilities: Comprehensive understanding of business and finance concepts. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Proficient managerial and diplomacy capabilities. Mastery of Microsoft Office Suite. Outstanding organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or related field. Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience. Candidates should either possess the ServSafe Manager Certification upon joining or acquire it within an agreed timeframe post-hiring. Physical Requirements Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Able to lift up to 25 pounds, especially when handling produce crates. Regular travel within the assigned region, with occasional national trips. Work Environment Dynamic retail environment with a strong emphasis on fresh produce quality and safety. Regular visits to franchise locations, interacting with staff, observing operations, and possibly handling produce directly. Equal Opportunity Statement We are an equal opportunity employer, deeply valuing diversity. Our commitment is to foster an inclusive environment for all employees, basing employment decisions on merit, qualifications, and business needs. Other Duties Please note this job description isn't exhaustive. Duties and responsibilities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

review_candidates.title: Quality Assurance Manager
review_candidates.description: Quality Assurance Manager – MalawiAbout the Opportunity We are supporting a pharmaceutical manufacturing company in Malawi in the recruitment of an experienced Quality Assurance Manager to join its senior management team. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing quality and compliance activities relating to the manufacture and packaging of both solid and liquid pharmaceutical products, ensuring that products are manufactured in accordance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP). The company is open to recruiting experienced pharmaceutical professionals from Malawi, Zimbabwe and across Africa . International candidates with relevant pharmaceutical manufacturing experience are encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities The Quality Assurance Manager will be responsible for: Managing and maintaining the Quality Management System. Managing deviations and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions). Overseeing batch release activities. Ensuring audit and inspection readiness and compliance. Overseeing change control processes. Providing technical expertise and guidance to senior management on quality-related matters. Developing quality and compliance measures, plans and strategies to proactively address quality risks. Supporting pharmaceutical trials and new product development. Developing and reviewing documentation for trial and final product dossiers. Monitoring compliance with cGMP and applicable pharmaceutical regulations. Supporting and conducting quality audits and inspections. Working closely with relevant departments to identify and address GMP violations and non-conformances. Preparing observations relating to non-conformance. Supporting laboratory quality systems and Quality Control manufacturing operations. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in a scientific field such as Pharmacy, Chemistry or Chemical Engineering . An advanced qualification in Quality Management or Regulatory Affairs is an advantage. Minimum 3 years' experience in a similar Quality Assurance role within the pharmaceutical industry . Minimum 7 years' experience in a pharmaceutical analytical laboratory, Quality Assurance or Quality Control environment . Demonstrated knowledge of the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry, cGMPs and government regulations. Knowledge of current stability guidelines and stability procedures. Experience developing protocols for trials and new pharmaceutical products. Strong experience in pharmaceutical documentation, particularly trial and final product dossiers. Knowledge of analytical chemistry within a GMP environment is an advantage. Understanding of laboratory quality systems. Understanding of statistical principles is an advantage. Strong experience with audits. Skills & Competencies The successful candidate should demonstrate: Strong leadership and decision-making abilities. Critical thinking and a strong quality mindset. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong organisational and project management abilities. Ability to work independently and collaboratively. Ability to communicate effectively across different departments. Ability to influence, consolidate and present information to senior management. Strong computer skills. Ability to identify GMP violations and work effectively with relevant quality and GMP personnel. Relocation & Benefits The employer is actively recruiting internationally and will support the successful candidate with: Work permit and immigration processing. Relocation assistance. Flights. Accommodation/housing. Company transport. Medical cover for the employee and dependents. Performance-based bonuses linked to KPIs and targets. Airtime and data. Additional settling-in support where required. Salary Competitive and negotiable , depending on the candidate's qualifications, experience and suitability for the position. Location Malawi Candidates from Zimbabwe and across Africa are encouraged to apply. Previous experience working in Malawi is not required; relevant pharmaceutical manufacturing experience from Africa or internationally will be considered. Expected Start Date November 2026 How to Apply Qualified candidates should submit their CV through LinkedIn or send their CV to: talent@connectoutsourcing.co.zw Please indicate “Quality Assurance Manager – Malawi” in the subject line.
